recG4mC1e79KaK37p.Bio: Jason Quitt is a Canadian author and researcher of ancient mysticism, sacred geometry and archaeo-astronomy, and the founder of The Crystal Sun. A graduate of the Institute of Energy Wellness who has studied energy modalities, shamanism and Qi Gong since 2002, he has taught and lectured on mysticism, meditation and out of body experience since 2010. His books include Egyptian Postures of Power, The Yosef Codes, Astral Genesis, Gates of the Anunnaki and Astral Experiences. His latest, The Shining Island: Precession, Axis Mundi, & Plato's Celestial Allegory, reads Plato's Atlantis not as a sunken empire but as a celestial allegory encoding the fall of the pole star and the precession of the Great Year.
recG4mC1e79KaK37p.Name: Jason Quitt
recG4mC1e79KaK37p.Role: Author & researcher of ancient mysticism, sacred geometry & archaeo-astronomy

fields.Intro Paragraph 1: The sacred number system of ancient Babylon is literally encoded in your bones. Jason Quitt, archaeosymbologist and author of Gates of the Anunnaki, returns to InnerVerse with mathematical proof that a universal knowledge system underlies every ancient culture on Earth.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: Jason Quitt, archaeosymbologist, esoteric researcher, and author of Gates of the Anunnaki: Sacred Geometry Keys to the Gods, returns to InnerVerse to decode the case for a universal ancient knowledge system. The conversation covers the ancient aliens narrative reframed through Jungian depth psychology, reading Sumerian and Egyptian texts as allegory rather than literal history, the gods as constellations and the sky as the first written language, the Babylonian sexagesimal system mirrored precisely in the 30 bones of each arm and throughout the human skeleton, the Anunnaki as children of the sky and earth whose hierarchy maps the levels of creation, the solar myth of the dark waters from Tiamat to Nun to Ra, the seven sages and Noah as the same world age doctrine across every culture, the identical cosmic serpent creation myth on both sides of the Earth in Babylon and Mesoamerica, the 23.5 degree axial tilt encoded in sacred idols from Egypt to South America, and the number 1.728 hidden in the texts of the Epic of Gilgamesh and the Hindu Kali Yuga.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "The Descent of Inanna Hides a Resurrection Code", "body": "Jason walks through the myth of Inanna's journey to the underworld to attend the funeral of the Bull of Heaven, tying it to the number 72, since three days and three nights repeats everywhere from the winter solstice to Lazarus and the resurrection of Jesus. She passes seven gates and is hung on a meat hook as a corpse, and her husband Dumuzi begs the sun god Utu to turn him into a serpent so he can escape the underworld's demons, the same escape Jason connects to Noah's ark and Vishnu reclining on a serpent boat."}, {"title": "Your Skeleton Runs on Sumerian Math", "body": "Jason traces the Sumerian base 60 number system directly into human anatomy: 30 bones in each arm and hand, 60 in each leg, a spine that starts with 33 vertebrae and fuses down to 26, matching the alphabet, a skull built from 22 bones, matching Hebrew's 22 letters, and 12 ribs. He argues these numbers were not arbitrary units but literally read off the body, and that the ancients used thrown lots and bones for divination precisely because the body already held the pattern of the cosmos within it."}, {"title": "A Cow Hymn That Measures the Moon", "body": "Jason unpacks the 4,000 year old Sumerian Hymn to the Herds of Nana, a strange poem counting the moon god's heavenly cattle: 39,600 cows, 108,000 young cows, 126,000 white cows. He shows those figures matching real astronomical numbers, the earth's radius of 3,960 miles, the moon's radius of 1,080, their combined 5,040, and the moon's farthest orbital distance of 252,000 miles, arguing the same sequence recurs in the Epic of Gilgamesh and the Sumerian King List as evidence of a deliberately encoded sacred geometry."}, {"title": "Ishtar Is Drawn to the Season", "body": "Using the Seal of Adda and the Burney Relief, Jason shows Ishtar's carved form built entirely on 23.5 degree lines, from her womb to the eyes of the lion beneath her, and through her wings and the angle in her right hand, while her left hand points at 15 degrees, the sun's hourly movement. Standing on Leo with a Virgo shaped mark on her neck, opposite Pisces on the same seal, her whole image becomes an astrological diagram of the seasons, the earth's 23.5 degree tilt rendered directly into a goddess's proportions."}, {"title": "Sacred Geometry Was Built to Last", "body": "Chance and Jason frame the encoding of solar angles into idols as intentional technology rather than decoration, calling it mimicry magic: taking the measured angles of the sun and building them into a solar deity's proportions to put the artifact in resonance with a real cosmic force. They tie this to why the imagery keeps recurring for thousands of years, arguing that civilizations which ritually replicated this sacred pattern, the seed and order pulled out of chaos, generated more longevity than ones that treated the art as free expression."}]
